name: vitals
description: A slim band above your prompt: usage left in the 5-hour and 7-day windows with reset times and a pace check that warns before you run out, how full the context is, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold.

startIn.title: Start each session in
startIn.description: The band's look when a session starts. Press the button on the band to switch for the rest of the session.

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache lasts (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long after Claude's last request the cache counts as warm. 60 on plans with the 1-hour cache, 5 otherwise.

inputPrice.title: Your model's input price ($ per million tokens)
inputPrice.description: Used to estimate what the next message costs. 0 hides the dollar figure and shows tokens only.

lowAt.title: Warn when a window has less than this % left
lowAt.description: The window turns red and shows LOW below this.
